19b4696c165b97b9.title: Compulsory Skill Development Program
19b4696c165b97b9.summary: A compulsory skill development program for first-year students at IIT MANDI, conducted in collaboration with IBM (SkillBuild) and IIT Bombay (Mood Indigo). The program runs from January 2026 to March 2026 and aims to strengthen industry-relevant skills, offering four industry-recognized certificates, real-time projects, and mentor-led sessions. A program fee is applicable.
